verdict.rationale: Claude ships an official desktop app, including Linux installation via an apt repository, and Cowork's computer-use mode can work directly on your screen by clicking, typing and opening apps. That covers the desktop-app and screen-access parts of the story, but nothing in the evidence documents OS-level or global keyboard shortcuts. Missing for 10: OS-level/global shortcut evidence, explicit docs on reading on-screen context outside agentic computer use, independent hands-on corroboration.
